title: 許可・拒否ルールの解釈系ギャップ追加事例：deny規則がオプション値を素通し、括弧パスがsandboxで無言に脱落、隠れたコマンド置換を自動承認
summary: Material update to P-20260831-60EFB5BF (command allowlist interpreted differently from the execution engine). Claude Code shipped four fixes for the same mechanism in one week: v2.1.259 'Fixed Bash Read() deny rules not covering files given as option values or operands' (deny rules bypassed when a protected file appears as a command option value or operand rather than a recognized argument position); v2.1.260 'Fixed Edit/Write/Read rules with parentheses in path being dropped or ignored by sandbox' (rules silently discarded, so the sandbox enforced less than configured); v2.1.260 'Fixed one uncompilable file permission pattern failing all file edits; such rules now guard' (a single malformed pattern collapsed the whole rule set); v2.1.260 'Fixed Bash auto-approving zsh commands hiding command substitution in specific variable assignments' (auto-approval failed to see command substitution nested in variable assignments). Confirms the cataloged mechanism is broad — parsing gaps exist on both allow and deny sides, fail both open and closed, and were still being discovered in the 2026-09 window; the provider fixed these specific instances.
